title: Antibacterial, antioxidant, and scolicidal activity investigation of biosynthesized ZnO NPs using Zhumeria majdae essential oil and hydroalcoholic extract
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,23461-23476
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01192B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Rana Kiani, Zahra Rafiee, Damoun Razmjoue, Ahmad Oryan, Mehrorang Ghaedi, Hassan Abidi
ZnO NPs was synthesized by green synthesis method, using Zhumeria majdae plant and it was characterized. The essential oil and hydroalcoholic extract were made and their antibacterial, antioxidant, and scolicidal activities were investigated.
